description: This file is a shell script used for platform-specific upgrade procedures and hardware configuration in an embedded Linux environment, particularly for OpenWrt firmware upgrades on devices with Qualcomm Atheros hardware. It defines functions for managing firmware partitions, toggling root filesystem configurations, and performing device-specific upgrade steps.

methods.name: remove_oem_ubi_volume
methods.description: Removes a specific OEM UBI volume from the NAND device.

methods.name: qihoo_bootconfig_toggle_rootfs
methods.description: Toggles the primary boot configuration for the root filesystem partition.

methods.name: tplink_get_boot_part
methods.description: Determines the current boot partition, either from kernel command line or U-Boot environment.

methods.name: tplink_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a firmware upgrade on TP-Link devices, toggling the boot partition.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Placeholder function for checking if the image is valid; always returns success.

methods.name: yuncore_fap650_env_setup
methods.description: Sets up environment variables for yuncore fap650 devices.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that performs device-specific upgrade procedures based on device type.
